figure.caption: Figure 1: The landscape of Geneverse. We then adjust the base model with different strategies and select the best candidate. To generate MLLMs for genomic and proteomic analysis, we incorporate the training datasets from known databases, including both descriptions and corresponding images. We then finetune the base model with different strategies and select the best candidate. The logo of Geneverse is generated by DALLE (OpenAI, 2024).
